title: Manager: small fixes left by task 037 (consult exit code, consult cost note, line numbers after abbreviations, labels against verdicts for task 56)
item: Give checks.py consult a distinct exit code when the task file is missing; say in SKILL.md that consult re-runs the paid claude-api check for a task with outside_needs; stop LINE_NUMBER counting a (n) after an abbreviation such as 'e.g.'; add a step that compares the advisor's blind labels (job a) with the verdicts, for a line like task 56 line 3

Today a consult crash and a real always-park both exit 1; no done_means writes 'e.g. (n)'; and task 56 line 3, the advisor's first real use, needs labels compared with verdicts that job (a) never sees.
notes: Also noticed by the builder: commands/manage.md line 70 is 147 characters long (older than task 037). Dropped 2026-11-17: folded into task 066, the one manager loose-ends task. This file stays as the list of what task 066 fixes.
